definitions.explanation: A sound in the low frequency range. Used for music, voices, and audio equipment.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{低音|ていおん}の{声|こえ}が{魅力的|みりょくてき}だ。
このスピーカーは{低音|ていおん}がよく{出|で}る。
{低音|ていおん}が{響|ひび}く{音楽|おんがく}を{聴|き}くと、{体|からだ}に{振動|しんどう}が{伝|つた}わってくる。
examples.english: When you listen to music with deep bass, you can feel the vibrations in your body.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {低|てい} (low) + {音|おん} (sound). Used in music, audio equipment, and voice descriptions. The opposite is {高音|こうおん} (high-pitched sound).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低音|ていおん}の{声|こえ} (a low voice)
- {低音|ていおん}が{響|ひび}く (the bass resonates)
- {低音|ていおん}{域|いき} (bass range)
- {重|おも}{低音|ていおん} (deep bass)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高音|こうおん}: high-pitched sound — the antonym
- {低温|ていおん}: low temperature — a homophone with different kanji
